text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (August 1, 2023) for 35 Jansusie Road.

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (August 1, 2023) for 35 Jansusie Road, Folder Number: 23 180257 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to June 19, 2024. 2. Modified the Property Standards Order (August 1, 2023) for 35 Jansusie Road, Folder Number: 23 180257 PRS 00 IV, to include in the Required Action section for each Items 1 to 3, the following wording, "repair or replace guards and handrails as applicable".
